summary: Completed testing of FamFocus Hub new chat features (voice messages, emoji reactions) and notification system. All 21 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All new chat features implemented correctly
Message reactions API (POST /api/messages/{id}/react) working - supports add/remove toggle
Notification APIs working: GET /api/notifications, PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read, PUT /api/notifications/read-all, DELETE /api/notifications/clear
Voice message endpoint (POST /api/messages/voice) exists and validates input correctly

test_credentials.method: Dev Parent Login button on login page

seed_data_creation: Test messages created via API for reaction testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat features (emoji reactions, voice recorder, emoji picker) and notification system fully tested. Sidebar dropdown menu in collapsed state shows all navigation items correctly.

sidebar_dropdown_collapsed.details: Floating pill button opens dropdown with all 15+ navigation items, user info, Expand and Logout buttons

chat_emoji_picker.details: Emoji button (data-testid='emoji-button') shows emoji grid with 12 quick emojis when clicked

chat_voice_recorder.details: Voice button (data-testid='voice-button') shows voice recorder component with 'Tap to record' UI

chat_message_reactions.details: Clicking message bubble shows emoji reaction picker (data-testid='emoji-reaction-picker') with ❤️👍😂😢😡 options

notification_bell.details: Notification bell (data-testid='notification-bell') visible in sidebar, opens notification panel when clicked

api_message_react.details: POST /api/messages/{id}/react - adds/removes reactions, returns 400 for missing reaction type, 404 for non-existent message

api_notification_read.details: PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read - marks single notification as read

api_notification_read_all.details: PUT /api/notifications/read-all - marks all notifications as read for family

voice_messages: POST /api/messages/voice (endpoint exists) - PASS (returns 422 for empty data)

features: Dropdown menu opens with all items
